# Vendored libavoid JavaScript/WebAssembly

Package: libavoid-js 0.5.0-beta.5 (npm), retrieved 2026-10-20.
Repository and source/build instructions: https://github.com/Aksem/libavoid-js
Upstream C++ source: https://github.com/mjwybrow/adaptagrams/tree/master/cola/libavoid
Package archive: https://registry.npmjs.org/libavoid-js/-/libavoid-js-0.5.0-beta.5.tgz
Archive integrity: sha512-jHkn6A10815TgFhZ1paUD/NDnQkg4C66qJc2Juj1NpmO/+QXnJ4UjIdKQarkXLmI/QgXhEO3RWDxMi3i+uHPwA==

The browser distribution files index.js, index.js.map and libavoid.wasm are
redistributed unmodified. Full LGPL 2.1 text is included in LICENSE. Upstream
libavoid notices permit LGPL 2.1 or later. The source repositories provide the
corresponding code and build tooling; the npm README describes the build.
This distribution keeps the dependency as separate, replaceable files. No CDN
or package installation is needed by the extension at runtime.

Research references: https://www.adaptagrams.org/documentation/libavoid.html
